title: You could have invented transformers from memory
summary: This article explains how the transformer architecture (the foundation of GPT, BERT, and modern LLMs) can be intuitively understood through the lens of associative memory, showing how self-attention mechanisms naturally emerge from memory recall patterns.
problem_solved: Makes the transformer architecture intuitive and accessible by deriving it from associative memory concepts.
why_valuable: Provides a novel intuitive framework for understanding one of the most important architectures in modern AI, bridging the gap between theoretical foundations and practical implementation.
